lines.speaker: AVA
lines.text: Thanks for calling — this is AVA. How can I help?

lines.speaker: CALLER
lines.text: My water heater is leaking all over the garage floor. Like, right now.

lines.speaker: AVA
lines.text: Okay — you called the right place. Quick check: is it spraying, or seeping from the bottom?

lines.speaker: CALLER
lines.text: Seeping. I already shut the water off at the—

lines.speaker: AVA
lines.text: Perfect — you're ahead of me. That was the exact right move, Sarah.

lines.speaker: CALLER
lines.text: Can someone come tonight? What's that cost?

lines.speaker: AVA
lines.text: Tonight's emergency visit is one-forty-nine. Or seven A-M tomorrow is our standard fifty-nine dollar trip fee. Which works?

lines.speaker: AVA
lines.text: Seven A-M tomorrow, booked. Confirmation text is on its way to you right now.

lines.speaker: AVA
lines.text: Keep a couple towels on it tonight — you handled this exactly right.
